prompt:
State the typical resolution of each of the following measuring instruments:
(i) a standard laboratory metre rule with millimetre graduations, [1]
(ii) a standard mechanical micrometer screw gauge. [1]
hints: What is the smallest interval marked on a school ruler?
How finely does a micrometer thimble read?
teacher_walkthrough: (i) A standard metre rule has smallest divisions of 1 mm.
(ii) A standard micrometer has pitch 0.5 mm with 50 thimble divisions, giving 0.5 / 50 = 0.01 mm.

provenance.independence_statement: Standard recall of metre rule and micrometer resolutions.
